dataset.name: NCEP North American Regional Reanalysis (NARR)
dataset.rationale: NARR and seasonal windows are source-faithful to Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024; PAYOFF-B primary predictive-connectivity preprocessing uses its own preregistered linear-detrend definition, with the source ARIMA analysis retained as external calibration.

variables.precipitation: daily accumulated total precipitation at surface

predictive_connectivity.training_window: 20 complete years ending at focal year - 1
predictive_connectivity.spatial_aggregation: unweighted mean of native NARR grid-cell centers falling inside each source-backed route polygon
processing: compute annual context-window mean 2 m temperature
compute annual Bylot target-window mean 2 m temperature
within each trailing 20-year pre-focal window regress context and Bylot annual means separately on calendar year
signed Pearson correlation of the two OLS residual series is primary predictive_connectivity_rho
predictive_connectivity.leakage_rule: no focal-year or future-year temperature may enter q

primary_temporal_processing.method: within each 20-year trailing pre-focal window, regress source and Bylot annual window-mean temperature separately on calendar year by ordinary least squares and correlate the two residual series
primary_temporal_processing.rationale: deterministic PAYOFF-B predictive-connectivity coordinate; matches the existing broad-bird information-axis definition and avoids rolling ARIMA model-selection degrees of freedom
primary_temporal_processing.source_relation: NOT identical to Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024, which correlated residuals from ARIMA time-series models over 1979-2018

source_faithful_calibration.role: external calibration / sensitivity only, not primary focal q
source_faithful_calibration.published_method: Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024 fit ARIMA models to each site-period series and correlated selected-model residuals
source_faithful_calibration.required_check: using the reconstructed fixed source polygons and source windows, compare PAYOFF-B linear-detrended correlations with the published ARIMA-residual Table 2 pattern before interpreting focal GPS results
source_faithful_calibration.no_retuning_rule: do not switch the focal primary q definition from linear detrending to ARIMA based on which gives a stronger movement result

decision_day_weather.spatial_rule: nearest native NARR grid cell to the focal GPS decision location
decision_day_weather.local_temp_anom3: focal 3-day ending mean 2 m temperature minus the mean of the same 3-calendar-day window across the 20 pre-focal years at that grid cell
decision_day_weather.same_day_temp_anom: focal daily 2 m temperature minus the mean for the same month-day across the 20 pre-focal years at that grid cell
decision_day_weather.precipitation: daily accumulated total precipitation on the focal decision date

wind_support.definition: project daily mean 10 m wind onto the fixed route bearing from current source-region centroid to the next source-region/Bylot centroid
wind_support.bearing_source: centroids of the frozen source-backed region polygons; never observed post-departure movement

missingness: fail closed for any decision day lacking required climate values; do not impute focal weather
forbidden_reframings: do not switch to ERA5 after outcome inspection
do not use same-year future Bylot temperature in q
do not choose St. Lawrence full-vs-short window by model fit
do not derive wind bearing from the bird's realized post-departure trajectory
